mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance pathways to the body was most worthwhile: the planned comparison of head and eye movements links the anatomy to a practical reflex, while acknowledging other inputs to posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two completed organ types was predictable and added little explanation beyond placing them together beside the cochlea.
